public.in_one_sentence: Events in Saudi Arabia or on pilgrim routes that could cause claims on pilgrim or migrant-worker cover.
tell_me_if: Saudi Arabia suspends, restricts or reopens Umrah or Hajj visas or flights from Indonesia
Attacks, security incidents or disease outbreaks affect Jeddah, Mecca, Medina or Saudi airports
Indonesian airlines or the government cancel pilgrim flights or evacuate citizens
Large health or crowd incidents are reported among Indonesian pilgrims
ignore: Hajj quota announcements with no change for Indonesia

match.headline: Saudi Arabia suspends Umrah visas amid Gulf tension
Missile intercepted near Jeddah, flights delayed
Indonesian pilgrims stranded after flight cancellations

not_match: Hajj fees announced for next year

serious: Pilgrim flights suspended for more than a week
private.notes: Pilgrim cover includes cancellation and medical evacuation.
